Rotation (Optional)

Sets the effective damage-per-turn summary. Leave it empty to compare spells one hit at a time. Ratio sets how often an attack is used relative to your basic attack: 1 means every turn, 0.5 means every other turn, 0.2 means once every 5 turns — it's used to weight each attack's contribution to your effective damage per turn.

AttackTargetsRatio
06

Targets (Optional)

Add creatures to account for defenses, kill ratios and charms to further improve the calculations. Ratio sets what share of your kills come from this creature relative to the others in this list — it's used to weight the results toward the fights you actually spend time in.
